attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Small, well-contained client-side JS change scoping event handlers to the closest widget-editor-body instead of an outer wrapper variable (fixing multi-widget bleed), but relies on the DOM always containing a '.widget-editor-body' ancestor which could throw a null-reference error in edge cases or custom themes lacking that class."}

reason: Small, well-contained client-side JS change scoping event handlers to the closest widget-editor-body instead of an outer wrapper variable (fixing multi-widget bleed), but relies on the DOM always containing a '.widget-editor-body' ancestor which could throw a null-reference error in edge cases or custom themes lacking that class.
